title: Atom (atoms/*.json, format v2)
description: One ruleset-authored atomic statement (format v2, sub-project 5c): a named, parameterized fragment of an ability's execution, contributing targeting/resolution/outcome pieces to whatever composition(s) include it. Only present under format_version "2" rulesets. See internal/rules/load.go (loadAtoms/decodeContribution) for the authoritative loader and internal/rules/compile.go for how a composition's param bindings flatten an atom's templates into a CompiledPower; this document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

params.description: Parameters a composition's "bind" object supplies concrete values for. A "{name}" placeholder anywhere in this atom's contributes templates must name one of these. Optional — omitted or [] both mean "no params" (same convention as ruleset.schema.json's optional attributes/defenses/resources arrays).

provides.description: Graph keys this atom makes available to other atoms in the same composition (execution-order dependency, spec §4) — plain, ruleset-chosen strings. Optional — omitted or [] both mean "provides nothing".

consumes.description: Graph keys this atom depends on. A composition is valid only if every consumed key is provided by exactly one atom in it and the resulting graph is acyclic; execution order is that graph's topological order. Optional — omitted or [] both mean "consumes nothing".

name.description: Matches the expression grammar's IDENT charset — substituted into "{name}" placeholders.

kind.description: int/expr are VALUE kinds: a binding splices into a contribution expression as a parenthesized parsed subtree — hygienic, the binding can never change the surrounding expression's precedence. attribute/resource/defense/condition are NAME kinds: a binding substitutes as a bare identifier into a ref position (e.g. "@caster.{attack_stat}") or a plain name field (e.g. a resource_change's "resource"), validated against the ruleset's declared vocabulary of that kind.

contribution.description: Exactly one of the three shapes below, selected by "kind".

intOrParam.description: A literal integer, or a JSON string holding EXACTLY one "{param}" placeholder naming an int-kind param — never a partial-text template or an arithmetic expression: targeting is a compile-time constant (CompiledPower.Targeting is v1's plain Targeting{Range,MaxTargets int}), not a runtime expression.

targetingContribution.description: Exactly one required per composition (across ALL its atoms combined).

resolutionContribution.description: At most one per composition (format v2.0). roll is compared to the vs threshold expression: roll total >= vs selects branches[0] (the ge-label), else branches[1] (the lt-label) — both flow into AbilityUsed.outcome_summary verbatim.

key.description: The provides/consumes graph key this resolution is filed under — an outcome contribution's "key" names this to condition itself on one of "branches".

roll.description: Two-actor-position expression template (every ref must be scoped: @caster.x / #target.y). May contain "{param}" placeholders.

vs.description: Two-actor-position expression template, the threshold roll is compared against.

branches.description: [ge-label, lt-label] — exactly 2 distinct, ruleset-chosen words; "always" is reserved for an unconditional outcome contribution's branch and cannot be used here.

key.description: Names the resolution (by its own "key") this outcome is conditioned on. MUST be null when branch is "always" (an unconditional effect-phase outcome needs no resolution); MUST be a non-null string otherwise.

branch.description: "always" (unconditional — runs regardless of any attack roll), or one of the referenced resolution's two "branches" labels.

effect.description: Exactly one of the three keys below — identical shape to ability.schema.json's v1 outcome, except string fields may contain "{param}" placeholders (name-kind substitution for resource/id, two-actor-position expression templates for delta_expr).

resource.description: A resource name declared in ruleset.json, or a "{param}" placeholder naming a resource-kind param.

delta_expr.description: Two-actor-position expression template. Applies to the ability's target's resource (spec-carried-over v1 semantic), even when the amount references @caster.*.

id.description: A condition id declared under conditions/, or a "{param}" placeholder naming a condition-kind param.
